invariant_definitions.waste_additivity: 有害廢棄物量 + 非有害廢棄物量 = 總重量(有害+非有害)
invariant_definitions.waste_ordering: 總重量 >= 有害廢棄物量 且 總重量 >= 非有害廢棄物量
invariant_definitions.waste_boundary_consistency: 三個廢棄物欄位的資料範圍應相同，否則總量不是同一口徑下的分項之和
invariant_definitions.infosec_implication: 受影響顧客數 > 0 蘊含 資訊外洩事件數量 > 0
invariant_definitions.fire_implication: 火災死傷人數 > 0 蘊含 火災件數 > 0

not_checkable: intensity x denominator = absolute (no filed denominator)

ghg_boundary_heterogeneity.why: inventorying scope 1 and scope 2 over different boundaries is permitted; a mismatch is an observation, not a rule violation. Counting it as gold would put judgement into G-A (INV-8).
